solar_market_value_october.question: What was the market value (capture price) of solar power in October 2026, and how does it compare with the official value?

input.a_label: Solar capture price from Energy-Charts data, Oct 2026

content.text:
The solar capture price in October 2026 (1–31 Oct, German local time) was **13.45 ct/kWh (134.49 EUR/MWh)**, calculated from day-ahead prices weighted by public net solar generation (Energy-Charts). The official TSO value is **13.39 ct/kWh**, so our figure is 0.06 ct/kWh (0.44%) higher. The official figure is status "reported" (not yet final), and the small gap is expected because the TSOs weight by their own extrapolated feed-in rather than by Energy-Charts' generation data.

Solar capture price is the generation-weighted average day-ahead price. The unweighted October average was 169.27 EUR/MWh, so solar's capture rate was about 79% of the average.

Sources: Energy-Charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE); Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de (day-ahead prices); netztransparenz.de (official monthly market value, as reported by Solarserver on 2026-11-10).

input.b_label: solar share of public net generation, 2–8 Nov 2026

content.text:
Wind's share was about 3.0 times solar's in public net generation from Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (ratio 3.006: 23.3% vs. 7.75%, a difference of 15.55 percentage points).

Source: Energy-Charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE)
